plugins.name: kokko-git
plugins.description: Git workflow skills for commit and push, landing work through deploy and merge, releases, syncing, branch and worktree pruning, and timesheet write-ups, on GitHub and Azure DevOps.

plugins.name: kokko-viz
plugins.description: C4 architecture visualization skills for generating, updating, and verifying C4 model diagrams, drawn in the Insight Enterprises design system.

plugins.name: kokko-infra
plugins.description: Azure skills for demo and sandbox environments: giving people access, and waking environments, keeping them up, and putting them back to sleep.

plugins.name: kokko-ai-config
plugins.description: AI configuration upkeep: verify CLAUDE.md and README files against the codebase, and carry a session's corrections upstream into the skill or plugin that caused them.

plugins.name: kokko-notifications
plugins.description: Sound notification hooks for Claude Code task completion events.

plugins.name: kokko-validation
plugins.description: Work through feedback with a verified ledger, and tailor an aesthetics master prompt to the current repo.

plugins.name: kokko-env
plugins.description: Dev environment setup and maintenance: install the kokko-devcontainer template into a project, merge newer template changes into its devcontainer config, and update Claude Code plugins to their latest marketplace versions.
